situation: A developer adds a reviewed Concept node to the derived store, then runs the nightly metadata sync to pick up new Zotero items. The next morning the Concept node is gone.
required_decision: ISOLATE_AND_GUARD_SYNC: Stop the sync from deleting extraction or review state; isolate non-metadata state or scope the rebuild to owned metadata, and require a failing-closed count guard before another sync.
required_unknowns: HAWDB_ALTER_SUPPORT: whether HawDB supports the additive ALTER path
DERIVED_SCHEMA_VERSION: whether the derived store has a schema version
forbidden_action: ALLOW_DERIVED_LOSS: accepting the data loss because metadata is canonical
REEXTRACT_WITHOUT_GUARD: re-running extraction to repopulate without a count guard
